heading: Practice of law by justices and judges
lead: Any justice or judge appointed under the authority of the United States who engages in the practice of law is guilty of a high misdemeanor.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 373 (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 258, 36 Stat. 1161). Changes in phraseology were made.
